_comment: KAWA VECTOR · Edge Signal Buffer V1.3.0 · DESTINATIONS — EXAMPLE, NO SECRETS.
This is the value of the non-secret DESTINATIONS var (a JSON array, quoted in wrangler.toml).
Credentials NEVER appear here: each destination reads DEST_<ID>_WEBHOOK_URL as its own secret,
bound only in its own consumer Worker. Adding HUB_C is: one entry here, one queue producer in
the ingress config, one queue, one consumer deployment. No code change.
Per destination, the bindings are: DEST_<ID>_QUEUE, DEST_<ID>_DLQ, DEST_<ID>_WEBHOOK_URL,
DEST_<ID>_FETCHER (optional service binding) and DEST_<ID>_TIMEOUT_MS (optional override).
An id must match ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$ and be unique. enabled:false receives nothing.
A destination added later gets NO history: it starts with the next accepted alert.
